title: Hellscape
description:
What is Hellscape?Hellscape is a text-based adventure game, full of puzzles, a little bit of combat, and a lot of terrible jokes. You play Hellscape using only a keyboard, by typing the actions you want to perform.What Awaits Me in Hell?• Puzzles, some designed by Satan himself

• A bunch of monsters. Demons, Skeletons, Goblins and more.

• Literally not one real graphic

• A terrible narrator

• Diet Paint?

• An endless stairway (Or is it?)

• A sick pair of shades that you can't see through...

• You can kiss the rat

• Other cool... stuff...

• Actually I think kissing the rat is the only good feature in the game
description_short: Hellscape is a "Based-Text" Adventure game. Similar to Text-Based games from the 80's, with a lighthearted twist, and way more balls jokes than ever necessary.
